Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

used in ear surgery.

3. Material 

3.1 Stainless steel conforming to Designation 3tifCr 13 of IS : 6603-1^' Specification for stainless 
steel bars and flats '. ^ 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 All surfaces of the hook shall be smooth and free from burrs, pits, cracks and other defects. 

4.2 The edges shall be even, rounded and no-where sharp. 

4.1 The hopk shall be forged in one piece and shall be well balanced and symmetrical at its central 
axis. 

^Mfc4The hoolf shall be finished smooth, matt finished and passivatecL 

4.5 The handle shall be properly knurled forge 

5. Heat Treatment — The hook shall be uniformly 'hardened and tempered to five a hardness 
of 350 to 450 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Flexibility — Grifr the handle firmly in a vice with its axis horizontal and the hook facing 
dpwnwards. Apply sufficient load to deflect the free end by 5 mm from its original position. Release 
the force, Repeat five times as mentioned above. No 'permanent set $hail be observed at the end 

of the test. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance -The hook shall pass boiling and autoclavjgg) test as specified in 
IS : 7531-1975 ' Method for boiling-and autoclaving test for corrosion reswtance of stainless steel 
surgical instruments \ 

7. Marking — The hook shall be marked legibly and indelibly with the manufacturer's name, initials 
or recognized trade-mark. t 

7.1 ISi Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing -*The hook shall be wrapped in moist&e-proof paper and packed in polyethylene bag 
in such a way that its working end is not damaged in handling. The hook may also be packed 
as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
